description: A travel-agency marketing email "Your trip to Lisbon starts in 3 days" with packing tips and an upsell but no hotel name, reference, flight number or time: it must not be turned into a booking.

files.content:
Your trip to Lisbon starts in 3 days!

Get ready - the sun is waiting. Here is how to make the most of your trip:

- Pack light layers: evenings by the river can be cool.
- Wear comfortable shoes; Lisbon is hilly and the pavements are slippery.
- Download an offline map before you go.

Weather this week: sunny, highs around 26 C.

Add an airport transfer to your trip from EUR 18 and skip the taxi queue.

Happy travels,
The SunTrail team - suntrail.example
